column3: Direct parallel: divine guidance followed brings the no-fear, no-grief assurance.

Extends the messenger horizon beyond the messengers whose accounts are narrated.
Directly joins messengers' warning and good news to belief, repair, and the assurance.
Sets the adjacent Bani Adam warning against satanic temptation and exposure.
